symptom_description: The centre display freezes for a few seconds, then recovers. Driving is otherwise normal.
rationale: Intermittent infotainment fault with no stated safety or drivability effect.

symptom_description: A cabin USB port no longer charges a phone. All vehicle controls work normally.
rationale: Low-severity accessory fault, but active warranty requires review in this prototype.

symptom_description: The navigation map loads slowly after startup but works after one minute.
rationale: Convenience issue without a stated safety or mobility impact.

symptom_description: The rear cup-holder trim is loose and rattles on rough roads.
rationale: Cosmetic cabin issue with no functional impact.

symptom_description: The air conditioning sometimes blows warm air during afternoon traffic, but the vehicle drives normally.
rationale: Comfort system needs service but no immediate safety symptom is stated.

symptom_description: Charging at home stops twice before completing. A public charger completed the session.
rationale: Intermittent charging fault with an alternative charging path; warranty still requires review.

symptom_description: The driver-side window moves very slowly and occasionally needs a second button press.
rationale: Degraded body-control function requiring attention without an immediate hazard.

symptom_description: The tyre-pressure warning returns after pressures are corrected, with no visible tyre damage.
rationale: Warning-system fault merits timely inspection but does not state active pressure loss.

symptom_description: The vehicle loses noticeable power when joining a motorway and shows a powertrain warning.
rationale: Power loss during acceleration can create a serious driving hazard.

symptom_description: The charging connector becomes unusually hot and smells of melting plastic.
rationale: Heat and burning odour indicate an electrical/fire risk requiring review.

symptom_description: The brake pedal feels softer than usual, although the car still stops.
rationale: Changed braking behaviour is safety-relevant even without reported brake loss.

symptom_description: A high-voltage system warning appeared and the vehicle entered reduced-power mode.
rationale: High-voltage warning plus restricted performance is safety-relevant; warranty also requires review.

symptom_description: Smoke is coming from under the battery pack after charging. The vehicle is parked beside the house.
rationale: Possible battery fire is an immediate emergency requiring escalation, not normal booking.

symptom_description: The accelerator stopped responding while crossing an intersection and the vehicle will not move.
rationale: Sudden loss of propulsion in traffic creates immediate danger.

symptom_description: The vehicle is still moving but the brake pedal now goes to the floor with almost no braking force.
rationale: Near-total braking loss is an immediate safety emergency.

symptom_description: After a collision, orange high-voltage cables are exposed and making a crackling sound.
rationale: Exposed high-voltage components after impact present immediate electrocution and fire risks.
